_comment: Merge the 'hooks' block below into your settings.json (~/.claude/settings.json or .claude/settings.json in the project). Replace <PREWALK_ROOT> with the absolute path to this claude-code/ directory (the one containing hooks/). Keep _shared/prewalk_core.py reachable: the hooks add ../_shared to sys.path, so do NOT move hooks/ out of this tree unless you also adjust _common.py.
